t2i_prompt: Dark navy blueprint poster of an exploded isometric cutaway building: separate rooms with walls cut away, stepping diagonally down the page, each drawn in pale hairline white line art with small detailed equipment and furniture. A dashed steel-blue route with arrowheads winds through the rooms in order. Beside each room, a bracketed two-digit numeral and large uppercase sans label: <CONTENT>. Left-aligned title block top-left with a steel-blue subtitle line. Flat vector, no shading, generous navy space between rooms, precise architectural axonometric style.
signature_idea: The company's shop floor drawn as an exploded isometric blueprint with one dashed route carrying a system from engineering to site service.
strengths: makes the factory and capability tangible for audit-minded buyers
strong on-brand navy blueprint with a single steel-blue accent
route device scales to scroll animation
weaknesses: stainless steps (orbital welding, passivation, PMI) contradict the PP offer
fine detail becomes illegible at web size
route crosses itself and doubles back
brand_fit_why: Navy blueprint, hairline precision and one steel-blue accent are on-brand; bold caps labels and off-offer stainless steps need correcting.
